response.justification: The candidate is a broadly experienced senior engineer with genuine distributed-systems exposure (low-latency DLang services handling millions of requests/sec) and long-standing mentoring/teaching activity, but he falls well short of the core minimum qualification of 8 years of C++ — his C++ experience amounts to roughly six months at National Instruments plus a thesis project. His career trajectory is primarily full-stack web (TypeScript/Node.js) rather than large-scale cloud compute infrastructure, and there is no evidence of formal technical leadership over cloud/DevOps teams at the scale this role demands.
strengths: Real high-throughput, low-latency systems experience (async I/O, fibers, caching) at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic
Strong mentoring and knowledge-sharing track record (workshops, courses, code katas, conference talks)
Long, versatile engineering career with open-source ownership and end-to-end project delivery (GISCollective on Kubernetes)
concerns: Far below the required 8 years of C++ experience (~6 months professionally; DLang is adjacent but not equivalent)
Recent roles are full-stack web/product engineering, not cloud compute platform or infrastructure at scale
No formal technical-lead title or demonstrated ownership of cross-team technical strategy for a large platform
